question: Which of the following parts of the alimentary canal carries out the complete digestion of carbohydrates, proteins and fats?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Small intestine.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Small Intestine:**

__
 
• It is the longest **part of the alimentary canal**, and it is **responsible for the complete digestion of carbohydrates, proteins, and fats**.
 
• It has three segments, the** duodenum, jejunum, and ileum**, each with specific functions in the digestion process.
 
• The duodenum receives chyme from the stomach and digestive juices from the pancreas and liver, where the** breakdown of carbohydrates, proteins, and fats begins.**
 
• The jejunum and ileum continue the digestion process and absorb the nutrients from the digested food into the bloodstream.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **oesophagus** is a muscular tube that connects the mouth to the stomach and** serves as a pathway for food to reach the stomach.**

 
 
• It has a **sphincter** at both ends that **prevents the backflow of food and gastric juices.**
 
 
 
• The **large intestine** is part of the digestive system, and it is **responsible for the absorption of water and electrolytes** from the remaining food material, producing feces, and eliminating them from the body.
 
• The **stomach is a muscular sac** that **receives food** from the esophagus and **mixes it with gastric juices** to partially digest proteins.
 
 
• It also regulates the release of food into the small intestine.
